facility.name: The Childrens Courtyard
facility.programs_provided: Accredited,After School Care,Transportation to/from School ,Field Trips

inspection_summary.note: Texas HHSC inspections, report investigations and assessments since October 2017, updated daily.

occurrences.finding: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation: It was determined that a caregiver was present in a classroom at the operation for more than a 2 week period with an incomplete background check status.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation (26 TAC §745.641)

occurrences.finding: Nutrition and Food Service - Food not a reward: It was found that a caregiver offering to pop children with a rubber band and if the children endured this, they would be given Taki chips or Marshmallows.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Nutrition and Food Service - Food not a reward (26 TAC §746.3301(h))

occurrences.finding: Director Responsibilities - Operate in Compliance: This was found to be deficient when the director of the operation allowed a caregiver to be present more than 2 weeks without an active background check.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Director Responsibilities - Operate in Compliance (26 TAC §746.1003(1))

occurrences.finding: Prohibited Punishments - Corporal Punishment: It was found that a caregiver was popping children with a rubber band as an alternative punishment to the standard practice of writing a report for behaviors exhibited.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Prohibited Punishments - Corporal Punishment (26 TAC §746.2805(1))

occurrences.finding: Fire Drill Monthly - Exit in 3 Minutes: The operation does not have a current fire drill on file.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Fire Drill Monthly - Exit in 3 Minutes (26 TAC §746.5205(1))

occurrences.finding: Children's Records Maintained: A child file was reviewed, the child files did not have a health statement, immunization record, and spacial needs recommendations.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Records Maintained (26 TAC §746.603(a))

occurrences.finding: Arrangement of Napping Equipment -All Children Supervised: The arrangement in the room did not allow a caregiver to have complete view of all children during naptime while trying to prevent a child from waking up the children who were sleep.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Arrangement of Napping Equipment -All Children Supervised (26 TAC §746.2909(5))

occurrences.finding: Prohibited Punishments - Grabbing and Pulling: A caregiver was observed pulling a child by the arm when redirecting the child.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Prohibited Punishments - Grabbing and Pulling (26 TAC §746.2805(3))

occurrences.finding: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment: Multiple rooms not being used by children in weeks have trash and food debris. This also includes the indoor play space that is being used by children. There were a few rooms that are being used that have food debris on some of the crawling mats that still need to be cleaned and sanitized.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment (26 TAC §746.3407)

occurrences.finding: Planned activities designed to meet special care needs-Integrated activities: Activities for a child with a special need were not develop and provided to a caregiver.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Planned activities designed to meet special care needs-Integrated activities (26 TAC §746.2202(4))

occurrences.finding: Determining Child/Caregiver Ratios - Developmental Age: A ratio was not adjust in order to provided the supervision and needs of a child with special need present.     Corrected during inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Determining Child/Caregiver Ratios - Developmental Age (26 TAC §746.1507(2))

occurrences.finding: Required Admission Information - Transportation Permission: Transportation Permission was not received in writing for a child who rides to school on a school bus.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Admission Information - Transportation Permission (26 TAC §746.605(8))

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Share Information with Incoming Caregivers: Staff did not verify information regarding a child transportation, as a result a child put on a school bus by mistake.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Share Information with Incoming Caregivers (26 TAC §746.1203(10))

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Demonstrate Competency, Good Judgment, Self-control: Staff did not verify a child identity before placing the child on a school bus, as a result another child was put on the bus instead.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Demonstrate Competency, Good Judgment, Self-control (26 TAC §746.1201(1))

occurrences.finding: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity: A child was found unsupervised at the parking lot.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Furnishings and Equipment for Toddlers - Enough Available to Prevent Competition: Not enough toy or items were observed during the inspection, as a result the children were observed trying to climb on shelf, out of control and fighting over toys.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Furnishings and Equipment for Toddlers - Enough Available to Prevent Competition (26 TAC §746.2505(2))

occurrences.finding: Safety - Electrical Outlets Covered: Electrical outlet in one of the room inspected did not have an electrical outlet cover, the cover around was loose was had tape around it.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety - Electrical Outlets Covered (26 TAC §746.3701(1))

occurrences.finding: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity: A caregiver was not providing the level of supervision necessary to ensure safety of the children, the children age were 18 months to 3 years old, while the caregiver was changing diaper it was observed children running, around, climbing on furniture, fighting  over toys.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Electronic Records-Available During Business Hours: Not all trainings certificates or documentations for staff were available for review.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Electronic Records-Available During Business Hours (26 TAC §746.805(3))

occurrences.finding: Sanitize Tables Tops, Furniture and Similar Equipment: The sink that is use for hand washing in one of the room inspected, was observed with old food  around and accumulated on the drainage.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Sanitize Tables Tops, Furniture and Similar Equipment (26 TAC §746.3407(11))

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Know number of children responsible for: A caregiver did not know how many children she had under her care after asked few times.     Follow Up  7/17/2024: Three caregivers were not aware how many children were under their care.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Know number of children responsible for (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(2))

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Know number of children responsible for: A caregiver did not know how many children she had under her care after asked few times.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Know number of children responsible for (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(2))

occurrences.finding: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - Pre-Service Training: One employee did not have annual training available for review.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - Pre-Service Training (26 TAC §746.1301(a)(2)(A))

occurrences.finding: Required Personnel Records - Required Affidavit: 2 Employees did not have affidavit on file at time of inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Personnel Records - Required Affidavit (Form 2985) (26 TAC §746.901(4))

occurrences.finding: Documentation of Annual Sanitation Inspection: One of the best ways to prevent health and safety emergencies and ensure children remain safe is to keep all inspections and  required documents current.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Documentation of Annual Sanitation Inspection (26 TAC §746.3403)

occurrences.finding: Documented Annual Training - Caregivers of Children Under 24 Months Required: Two infant caregivers did not have current sids/shaken baby training on file.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Documented Annual Training - Caregivers of Children Under 24 Months Required (26 TAC §746.1309(d))

occurrences.finding: Reporting Suspected Abuse, Neglect, Exploitation: During the follow up inspection it was bought to my attention a parent had a concern that was not reported to licensing in a timely manner.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Reporting Suspected Abuse, Neglect, Exploitation-May not delegate responsibility to report (26 TAC §746.201(5))

occurrences.finding: Medication No Longer Used: The operation had a expired epi pen in the child's classroom at the time of the investigation walkthrough.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Medication No Longer Used (26 TAC §746.3809)

occurrences.finding: Food Service and Preparation Requirement - Use Sanitary Holders: Caregiver in the Toddler room was feeding children snack off the table no sanitary holders were being used.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Food Service and Preparation Requirement - Use Sanitary Holders (26 TAC §746.3317(6))

occurrences.finding: Posting Requirements - Child's Food Allergy Plans: Child's food allergy plans were not posted in the classroom at the time of investigation inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Posting Requirements - Child's Food Allergy Plans (26 TAC §746.403(b))

occurrences.finding: Posting Requirements - Child's Food Allergy Plans: This standard was evaluated in regards to a report and found deficient. The allergy plan was not posted in the classroom at the time of the inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Posting Requirements - Child's Food Allergy Plans (26 TAC §746.403(b))

occurrences.finding: Medication No Longer Used: The operation had a expired epi pen in the child's classroom at the time of the investigation walkthrough.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Medication No Longer Used (26 TAC §746.3809)

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Caregivers- Supervision of Children: This standard was evaluated in regards to a report and found  deficient. A child was left outside unsupervised when a caregiver failed to properly account for all children in her care.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Supervision of Children (26 TAC §746.1203(4))

occurrences.finding: Parental Communication - Situation that Placed a Child at Risk: This standard was evaluated in regards to a report and found deficient. A child was left outside unsupervised and the parent was not notified immediately or given and incident report when the child was picked up.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Parental Communication - Situation that Placed a Child at Risk (26 TAC §746.307(b)(4))

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Demonstrate Competency, Good Judgment, Self-control: This standard was evaluated in regards to a report and found deficient. A child was left outside unsupervised when a caregiver failed to follow company policy and complete a name to face check when taking the children inside.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Demonstrate Competency, Good Judgment, Self-control (26 TAC §746.1201(1))

occurrences.finding: Written Feeding Instructions - Signed and Dated by Parent or Health-Care Professional: Feeding instructions were not all file for all infants in care.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Feeding Instructions - Signed and Dated by Parent or Health-Care Professional (26 TAC §746.2421(a))

occurrences.finding: Annual Sanitation Inspection - Conducted Local Sanitation Official: Operation did not have a current Health inspection on file at the time of inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Annual Sanitation Inspection - Conducted Local Sanitation Official (26 TAC §746.3401(b))

occurrences.finding: Annual Fire Inspection - Conducted by Fire Marshal: Operation did not have a current Fire Inspection on file.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Annual Fire Inspection - Conducted by Fire Marshal (26 TAC §746.5101(b))
